technical-summary: Contract amendment 12 (owner decision): engine-only manifests with zero helpers, optional handoff and helper_common tied to helper presence. The serving resolver reads the compiled-in layouts.toml and archs.toml instead of a hard-coded recipe table, supports multi-card engines and derives engine.tp, tp_wire and kernels from the layout. Golden digests prove the six flashnext layout manifests are unchanged. Fixes TOML booleans read as integers.
user-summary-candidate: Dense and multi-card engine jobs can now be described by a serving manifest, the same single configuration method as the MoE layouts.
